title: Channels to present as Claude Code
description: Requests going to the channels you name are sent with Claude Code's headers, billing and identity system blocks and a CLI-shaped user id. A request that already carries them (Claude Code itself) keeps its own. The channel's API key is never touched.
risk.title: Your channel decides
risk.message: Whether a channel accepts this is the channel's decision, and presenting one client as another may break its terms. You take that risk for your own key.
providers.label: Providers
providers.hint: Provider ids or names, as the Providers page shows them. With none listed the plugin does nothing.
protocol.label: API it applies to
protocol.hint: A provider with several endpoints is matched only when the request goes out over this one.
version.label: CLI version
betas.label: anthropic-beta
betas.hint: Replaces the default set of Claude Code's beta flags (a comma-separated list). Empty keeps the default.
